items.title: Akiyama Film Takes Us Into the Vintage Corners of Hong Kong and Tainan with the Lomo MC-A
items.excerpt: Akiyama Film is back! Testing the new Lomo MC-A 35 mm camera with Lomography film, the team explored the retro streets of Hong Kong and Tainan to capture a raw, nostalgic vibe. Check out their results!

items.title: In Depth: A Grand Tour of Travel Photography
items.excerpt: For this In Depth piece, we will get into the early history of travel photography, from inspirations in painting to the use of portable cameras. Is it really true that what happens on vacation stays on vacation?

items.title: Levana Cynthia on Travel & Photography with the Petzval Art Lens
items.excerpt: We lent Indonesian photographer Levana Cynthia the Petzval Art Lens in time for her travel to India and the United States, and she sent back love stories photographed across grand landscapes and intimate moments.

items.title: Now & Then in London: To Be (in Frame) or Not To Be
items.excerpt: I took along a few old photos as inspiration for our next stop on the Now & Then tour: London. But in truly analogue fashion, nothing went according to plan.

items.title: Lomography Community Recap: July 2026
items.excerpt: Here’s your monthly dose of the latest happenings in the Lomography Community! Curious as to what your fellow Lomographers have been up to, or want the latest scoop on our ongoing Competitions? Find all this and more in our monthly recap!

items.title: Stage Photographer Martinus Ragita Dives into the World of Lomography
items.excerpt: Martinus Ragita is a professional Indonesian stage and concert photographer widely recognized in the local music industry for capturing the energy and raw atmosphere of live performances. In this interview, he shares his experience 35 mm Lomography films.

items.title: Analogue Journal: Slowing Down Through Analogue Art with Lin (linnpingg__)
items.excerpt: Step into Lin's (linnpingg__) simple yet inspiring world in this edition of Analogue Journal. Through instant photographs and her hand-painted Lomo'Instant camera, she shares her everyday life, favorite hobbies, and the little moments that bring her joy.

items.title: Finding the Best Film for the Half-frame Simple Use Reloadable Film Camera: A Comparison of Lomography Film Stocks
items.excerpt: See how different Lomography films stocks work with the Half-frame Simple Use Reloadable Film Camera and find the right roll for your creative style.

items.title: Back to the Rhythm of Photography with Tom (toms.portra) and the Lomo MC-A
items.excerpt: Get to know portrait photographer Tom (toms.portra) through his portraits with the Lomo MC-A 35 mm Film Camera, which he took on a stroll through lush parks and Japanese street-inspired settings.

items.title: Fashion Photographer Mario Giovanni's First Impressions of the Diana F+
items.excerpt: Indonesia-based professional visual storyteller Mario Giovanni has carved out a niche in the creative industry by blending high-end fashion aesthetics with emotional storytelling. We let him try out the Diana F+ to see his own twist on the creative camera.

items.title: Through Generations: Grandma Kinso & Granddaughter Yan-Han Preserve Native Language & Family Memories Through Storytelling
items.excerpt: Grandma Kinso and Yan-Han run the Instagram account “Grandma Kinso's Stories”, dedicated to passing down memories and their mother tongue. We invited this grandmother-granddaughter duo to share their stories that span multiple generations.

items.title: Collecting Mailbox Memories: Stories from the Lomographers’ Print Exchange
items.excerpt: Meet five Lomographers from Latvia, Spain, Italy, Brazil, and Argentina as they each share what they sent and received for the Lomographers' Print Exchange.

items.title: Recap: Birmingham Design Festival LomoWalk
items.excerpt: 2026-08-03 #people#places![Image 13: Recap: Birmingham Design Festival LomoWalk](https://www.lomography.com/magazine/358672-recap-birmingham-design-festival-lomowalk) We brought a bit of Lomography magic to Birmingham Design Festival in the form of a LomoApparat LomoWalk complete with a mix of films and a lot of messing about. See some of the incredible results here and find out what participant Lauren Skillman had to say about the day.

items.title: New Kids: An Analogue Investigation of Contemporary Adolescence in Bologna by James Beghelli
items.excerpt: What happens when a photographer relinquishes control and allows teenagers to tell their own stories? In New Kids, James Beghelli gives Simple Use Cameras to young people in Bologna, turning film into a tool for exploration and self-expression.

items.title: Day vs Night: Testing the Half-frame Simple Use Reloadable Film Camera Under Changing Light
items.excerpt: Lomography writers @francinegaebriele and @nate_soriano take the Half-frame Simple Use Reloadable Film Camera on a day-versus-night run to see how it captures the changing light throughout an entire day.

items.title: The Extremes, Existentialism, and Artistry Behind Early X-Ray Photography
items.excerpt: What has the history of the x-ray got to do with experimental photography? More than meets the eye! This historical In Depth reveals some of the strange situations behind the scientific discovery of the x-ray, which shaped photography in daring and dangerous ways.

items.title: Lomography Partners: Share Your Story – Altrincham, Greater Manchester, UK
items.excerpt: Share Your Story in the UK is all about removing the barriers to storytelling. Store runner Simon Hepburn talks about the analogue-driven principles that fueled the shop's conception, and its growing creative community.

items.title: Pre Death Do Us Part: A Work in Progress by Jason Osayamen with the Joseph Petzval 55 f/1.7 Focus-coupled Bokeh Control Art Lens
items.excerpt: 2026-07-30 #news#videos![Image 19: Pre Death Do Us Part: A Work in Progress by Jason Osayamen with the Joseph Petzval 55 f/1.7 Focus-coupled Bokeh Control Art Lens](https://www.lomography.com/magazine/356766-pre-death-do-us-part-a-work-in-progress-by-jason-osayamen-with-the-joseph-petzval-55-f-1-7-focus-coupled-bokeh-control-art-lens) Jason Osayamen is working on his debut feature film, “Pre Death Do Us Part”, a psychological thriller set in Nigeria. He has been using the Joseph Petzval 55 f/1.7 Art Lens to complement the film's visual language, and talks about his ongoing project in this interview.

items.title: Solo Wedding Project: Bird (Film Full Photo) Captures Self-Love with the Lomomatic 110
items.excerpt: Thai photographer Bird, also known as Film Full Photo, uses the Lomomatic 110 to bring her Solo Wedding concept to life – a personal project created to share the idea that “Happiness doesn't depend on someone else – it begins with ourselves.”

items.title: First Impressions: Tree's Thailand Travel Snapshots with the Half-frame Simple Use Reloadable Film Camera
items.excerpt: We handed the new Half-frame Simple Use Reloadable Film Camera Classicolor to Tree, inviting her to document her travels across Thailand. After her trip, we talked about the journey, the camera, and how film keeps memories fresh.

items.title: The Soft and the Strong: Rebeca Morimoto and Her Customized La Sardina Camera & Flash DIY
items.excerpt: Big applause for the La Sardina by Rebeca Morimoto! The Peruvian Japanese illustrator brings her iconic style to this unique, customizable camera, giving La Sardina the punk, tattooed makeover she always deserved.

items.title: Clubhouse Paradiso Capture Scotland’s World Cup in Boston on the ActionSampler
items.excerpt: 2026-07-27 #people#videos![Image 23: Clubhouse Paradiso Capture Scotland’s World Cup in Boston on the ActionSampler](https://www.lomography.com/magazine/358935-clubhouse-paradiso-capture-scotland-s-world-cup-in-boston-on-the-actionsampler) The World Cup fever isn't over! We take a look at Ralph McClure and Keir Reid of Clubhouse Paradiso's visit to Boston for Scotland’s World Cup campaign, where the Glasgow-based duo created some stop animations of the events using the ActionSampler.

items.title: Dreamy Portraits & Vibrant Colors: Riccardo Montanini with the LomoChrome Classicolor 35 mm ISO 200
items.excerpt: Riccardo Montanini puts the new LomoChrome Classicolor ISO 200 to the test by capturing two contrasting worlds in a dual-themed portrait series, shot with the Petzval lens. Find out his first impressions in this interview.

items.title: Recap: London Graphic Centre LomoWalk
items.excerpt: 2026-07-26 #news![Image 25: Recap: London Graphic Centre LomoWalk](https://www.lomography.com/magazine/358671-recap-london-graphic-centre-lomowalk) We teamed up with London Graphic Centre for another fun-packed LomoApparat LomoWalk around Covent Garden and Soho using a mix of Lomography films.

items.title: Pride Parade Moments with the Lomography Half-Frame Simple Use Camera
items.excerpt: This year's Pride month, Lomography staff from across the globe attended Pride parades organized by their respective local communities, and capturing with them scenes of solidarity was the new Half-Frame Simple Use Camera, pre-loaded with Classicolor 200.

items.title: Whispers of the Summer Forest: Videographer Jihu Kim’s Dreamlike Imagery with the Joseph Petzval 27 mm f/1.7
items.excerpt: Jihu Kim headed into the forest with the Joseph Petzval 27 mm f/1.7 Focus-Coupled Art Lens to capture dreamlike scenes. Using the lens’s unique swirly bokeh and immersive wide-angle perspective, he beautifully translated the feeling of being drawn into nature.

items.title: Film Photography in Tune with Music: Meet Argenteurs
items.excerpt: 2026-07-24 #culture![Image 28: Film Photography in Tune with Music: Meet Argenteurs](https://www.lomography.com/magazine/358781-film-photography-in-tune-with-music-meet-argenteurs) From the Lomo MC-A on stage to the Lomography Color Negative ISO 400 film for a single cover, Argenteurs takes us behind the scenes of their analogue photography practice, using film to bring artists’ worlds to life and create lasting images.

items.title: Analogue Journal: Printing Memories with Artist Cat Caldarola (@talllcatart)
items.excerpt: Brooklyn-based artist Cat Caldarola shares how instant photography, journaling, and printmaking come together to preserve memories and inspire their creative practice.

items.title: Analogue Meets Subway Systems: Dami1992 Shooting on Colour Negative Film
items.excerpt: In this interview, David, a Czech photographer, introduces his fascination with metro stations and other liminal spaces. He also shares his experience working with Lomography Color Negative film, and offers advice on street photography.

items.title: First Rolls with the Half-frame Simple Use Reloadable Film Camera: Lomography Manila
items.excerpt: Get a glimpse of the Lomography Manila team's first adventure with the Half-frame Simple Use Reloadable Film Camera.
